# frozen_string_literal: true

require 'async'
require 'async/semaphore'

module PgWireProtocol
  PROTOCOL_VERSION = 0x00030000
  MAX_MESSAGE_SIZE = 1_073_741_824  # 1GB
  HEADER_SIZE = 4

  class MessageBuffer
    attr_reader :capacity, :position

    def initialize(initial_capacity = 4096)
      @buffer = String.new(capacity: initial_capacity)
      @buffer.force_encoding(Encoding::BINARY)
      @capacity = initial_capacity
      @position = 0
    end

    def write_int32(value)
      ensure_capacity(4)
      @buffer[@position, 4] = [value].pack('N')
      @position += 4
    end

    def write_int16(value)
      ensure_capacity(2)
      @buffer[@position, 2] = [value].pack('n')
      @position += 2
    end

    def write_bytes(data)
      ensure_capacity(data.bytesize)
      @buffer[@position, data.bytesize] = data
      @position += data.bytesize
    end

    def read_int32(offset)
      @buffer[offset, 4].unpack1('N')
    end

    def to_s
      @buffer[0, @position]
    end

    private

    def ensure_capacity(additional)
      required = @position + additional
      if required > @capacity
        new_capacity = @capacity
        new_capacity *= 2 while new_capacity < required
        @buffer << ("\x00" * (new_capacity - @capacity))
        @capacity = new_capacity
      end
    end
  end

  class RowDataDecoder
    # Decodes DataRow messages from PostgreSQL wire protocol
    # Format: 'D' | int32 len | int16 num_fields | (int32 col_len | bytes col_data)*
    
    def decode_row(raw_message)
      offset = 0
      msg_type = raw_message.getbyte(offset)
      offset += 1

      # Read total message length (includes self but not msg_type byte)
      total_length = raw_message[offset, 4].unpack1('N')
      offset += 4

      # Read number of columns
      num_columns = raw_message[offset, 2].unpack1('n')
      offset += 2

      columns = []
      num_columns.times do
        col_length_raw = raw_message[offset, 4].unpack1('N')
        offset += 4

        if col_length_raw == 0xFFFFFFFF
          # NULL value indicator
          columns << nil
        else
          # col_length_raw is unsigned 32-bit from network
          # Convert to signed for length calculation
          col_length = to_signed_int32(col_length_raw)
          
          if col_length > 0 && (offset + col_length) <= raw_message.bytesize
            columns << raw_message[offset, col_length]
            offset += col_length
          elsif col_length == 0
            columns << ""
          else
            raise ProtocolError, "Invalid column length: #{col_length}"
          end
        end
      end

      columns
    end

    private

    def to_signed_int32(unsigned_val)
      # Convert unsigned 32-bit to signed 32-bit interpretation
      if unsigned_val >= 0x80000000
        unsigned_val - 0x100000000
      else
        unsigned_val
      end
    end
  end

  class AsyncResultSet
    def initialize(connection, query_id)
      @connection = connection
      @query_id = query_id
      @rows = []
      @complete = false
      @decoder = RowDataDecoder.new
      @semaphore = Async::Semaphore.new(1)
    end

    def process_incoming_data(raw_messages)
      Async do
        @semaphore.acquire do
          raw_messages.each do |msg|
            case msg.getbyte(0)
            when 0x44  # 'D' - DataRow
              @rows << @decoder.decode_row(msg)
            when 0x43  # 'C' - CommandComplete
              @complete = true
            when 0x5A  # 'Z' - ReadyForQuery
              break
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end

    def fetch_batch(batch_size)
      Async do
        @semaphore.acquire do
          result = @rows.shift(batch_size)
          result
        end
      end.wait
    end

    def complete?
      @complete
    end

    attr_reader :rows
  end

  class ConnectionPool
    def initialize(pool_size: 5)
      @pool_size = pool_size
      @connections = []
      @semaphore = Async::Semaphore.new(pool_size)
    end

    def execute_query(query, params = [])
      Async do
        @semaphore.acquire do
          conn = acquire_connection
          begin
            result_set = AsyncResultSet.new(conn, generate_query_id)
            raw_response = conn.send_query(query, params)
            result_set.process_incoming_data(raw_response)
            result_set
          ensure
            release_connection(conn)
          end
        end
      end
    end

    private

    def acquire_connection
      @connections.pop || create_connection
    end

    def release_connection(conn)
      @connections.push(conn) if @connections.size < @pool_size
    end

    def create_connection
      MockConnection.new
    end

    def generate_query_id
      SecureRandom.hex(8)
    end
  end

  class MockConnection
    def send_query(query, params)
      # Simulates receiving wire protocol messages
      []
    end
  end

  class ProtocolError < StandardError; end
end
